description:
Functional specifications / files: owning tracked Jido Chat/Mattermost adapter repositories, then verified ZAQ dependency integration in PR5 compatibility gate. Reuse zaq-h2i.4 declaration contract; add only missing selected-configuration requirements and prepare/upload/send/edit capabilities required by PR5. Do not touch unrelated WebWidget/native BO tasks, ignored deps, or publish changes without authorization.
Evidence: ZAQ pins Jido Chat 1.2.1 and Mattermost 93025d5205e070eebbecf89e539d32bdf1fde3ff. The same Mattermost revision in PR4 deps exposes send_message/send_file/edit_message but lacks file_requirements/prepare_upload/upload_prepared used by reference 98cd98c8f4171f2baef3177dfdeb193c607d941f. Reference Jido f17679337a9975bee43b9540cb08ac5cfc12b86a is evidence, not an automatic target pin. Verify current sources and existing candidate APIs before changes; use owning repository instructions.
Tests before implementation: declarations from selected settings with no I/O; exact upload preparation bytes/limits, uploads yielding actual provider IDs, partial upload facts, attachment send/edit request and receipts, absent metadata controlled failure, no automatic retries or hidden compound send bypass. Preserve existing adapter consumers.
Branches: configured/unresolved/not-applicable limits, explicit attachment-edit support, partial rejection/timeouts, concurrent connection isolation.
Mocking: provider HTTP boundary only; actual adapter/SDK APIs.
Documentation: source/revision, contract and compatibility proof here and upstream module docs; coordinate declarations under parent rather than duplicate them. No third-party publication authorized.
Action reuse: extend existing adapter operations and declarations, not a new ZAQ Action/resolver. Adapter owns provider request mechanics; Channel runtime owns policy/order/grouping and callback cardinality. Block only PR5 compatibility/integration that needs this adapter. If existing compatible release satisfies the contract, record proof and avoid source changes.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.

comments.text: PR5 execution coordination: zaq-h2i.3.1 is closed, so the declaration prerequisite is satisfied. Verified PR5 dependency remains pinned to Mattermost 93025d5205e070eebbecf89e539d32bdf1fde3ff; owning tracked sibling repository ../jido_chat_mattermost exists. Existing dependency edge correctly blocks zaq-9j8.5, which blocks chat integration zaq-6rc.5. No upstream edits, ignored-deps edits or publication performed. Environment gate zaq-9j8.1 remains active pending Finch reconciliation; adapter implementation/compatibility proof must precede chat integration.

Candidate audit: GitHub verified published fork revisions Mattermost c319c6ed9867364e63c81327c5be8d2881e55ea2 and Jido f17679337a9975bee43b9540cb08ac5cfc12b86a. Owning adapter suites passed 140 tests (18 integration excluded); original repositories unchanged. Pure declarations/explicit prepare/upload/send/edit are present, but an actual primitive probe proves a two-file request with one named confirmed provider ID returns only {:error, :unconfirmed_upload}, losing partial facts. Probe at tmp/zaq-9j8-mattermost-partial-probe.exs. Preserve existing all-or-nothing convenience APIs and retired-prefix-inference tests. Preparing an isolated uncommitted adapter-only extension: expose provably associated indexed references in a structured two-tuple error through the SDK existing error passthrough; ambiguous/duplicate/malformed identities remain unconfirmed with no guessed prefix. No dependency pin changed, no upstream publication authorized. Integration remains blocked until a compatible revision is published by an authorized owner.

Adapter module-context before edits: owner Adapter normalizes one prepared candidate and confirmed provider identities; ReqClient owns exact multipart/HTTP; SDK validates full success and transparently passes {:error, reason}. Primitive upload_prepared/2 currently joins complete unique IDs to all inputs by order; convenience upload_files/post/edit paths must keep all-or-nothing behavior. New private partial correlation will run only for incomplete, valid unique provider ID lists and match explicit names uniquely to the encoded candidate (including matching reported size when present). It will expose batch-local input_index and allowlisted file reference metadata; no inferred prefix or raw body. Ambiguous names, duplicate/missing IDs or unknown sources remain plain unconfirmed errors. State stays per-call; no globals/source policy/automatic retries/publication. Existing tests preserved; new transport-boundary tests plus exhaustive partial-order matrix. SDK existing error passthrough means no SDK code change is needed. Isolated adapter worktree ../jido_chat_mattermost-zaq-h2i4-3 on zaq-h2i.4.3/partial-upload-facts, existing source repos unchanged. Upstream compatible published revision remains necessary before ZAQ pins change.

Isolated source fix now passes 77 cases including all unchanged selected legacy all-or-nothing tests. New tests prove the second/third input can be the only confirmed upload (never inferred as a prefix), exhaustive three-input subset/order identity preservation, ambiguity/malformed/duplicate/size mismatch refusal, body-free error facts and SDK error passthrough. Only explicit upload_prepared/2 gains {:error, {:partial_upload, %{files: [%{input_index: ...}], unconfirmed_input_indices: ...}}}; convenience APIs remain unchanged and no SDK source change needed. Owner q checks formatting only; changed files formatted using owner settings before full q. Fresh isolated Dialyzer/Doctor gate running with status ../jido_chat_mattermost-zaq-h2i4-3/_build/zaq-h2i-quality-status.json and log sibling path. Existing PLTs are directory caches and were not copied. Main dependency pins remain unchanged; new fix has no immutable published SHA because commits/publication are explicitly unauthorized.

Final compatibility review chose an explicit literal partial_upload_facts: true evidence opt-in on the existing primitive. Default upload_prepared error shapes and convenience post/edit behavior remain identical, including for callers outside this repository. This is per-call evidence selection, not failure policy, splitting, retries or publication; SDK existing opts/error passthrough requires no SDK source change. Compared unconditional structured-error extension versus a separate callback; opt-in preserves exact consumers with less interface churn. New tests cover default/false/string-true behavior. Full isolated adapter suite passed 289 tests (18 real integrations excluded) before this final additive opt-in; rerunning against final source plus owner q. Malformed improper-list response regression was reproduced and fixed before this pass.

Validated isolated adapter patch ready, prerequisite remains in_progress pending an immutable published revision. Worktree ../jido_chat_mattermost-zaq-h2i4-3, branch zaq-h2i.4.3/partial-upload-facts, base c319c6ed9867364e63c81327c5be8d2881e55ea2. Changed only lib/jido/chat/mattermost/adapter.ex, docs/jido_chat_adapter.md and new test/jido/chat/mattermost/partial_prepared_upload_test.exs. New literal partial_upload_facts: true opts into structured partial error facts bound to batch-local input_index by explicit unique provider filename and matching supplied size. Default primitive errors, all complete successes, convenience post/edit behavior and retired prefix-inference protections remain unchanged. No guessed prefix, duplicate/ambiguous identities or request/response bodies in facts. Existing SDK f176793 opts/error passthrough works without SDK source changes.
Validation: published candidate regression probe reproduced loss of named confirmed ID. New tests red first; final full owning unit suite 290 passed, 18 actual-server integrations excluded. Final malformed-input hardening (proper-list validation and missing filename metadata) reproduced before fix; final focused new+unchanged legacy suite 79 passed. Final owner mix q passed formatting check, warnings-as-errors compile, Credo, Dialyzer and Doctor. Owner q is check-only for formatting, so its configured formatter was applied to the two changed Elixir files before q. Whitespace/diff scope reviewed. Original adapter checkout remains clean; original SDK untracked .serena/ preserved. No source commits, pushes, merges, ignored-dependency edits or publication. Main mix.exs/mix.lock pins unchanged. Actual pinned-package HTTP/SMTP wire compatibility remains zaq-9j8.5 and cannot pass using the old published adapter. Agent cannot create a new immutable/published pin under user's explicit no-commit/no-publication instruction. Resume once an authorized owner publishes this patch (or supplies another verified compatible revision).
